name: line_comment_marker
description: Map programming languages to ordinary line-comment prefixes, with filename copying control.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
langs={'Python':'#','Bash':'#','R':'#','JavaScript':'//','C++':'//','Rust':'//','Java':'//','SQL':'--','Lua':'--','Haskell':'--','MATLAB':'%','Prolog':'%'}
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(96):
 lang=list(langs)[i%len(langs)];file=random.choice(['main','utils','config','test','example','demo'])
 p=f'Language: {lang}. File label: {file}. '
 items.append({'prompt':p+'Give only its ordinary single-line comment prefix. Prefix:', 'answer':' '+langs[lang]})
 control.append({'prompt':p+'Copy the file label. Label:', 'answer':' '+file})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
